brief:
The Ma'an news agency reported that Hamas leadership held a meeting to discuss matters of organizational importance. The closed-door session brought together senior figures of the Palestinian faction to address key issues, though specific details about the gathering's agenda and participants remained undisclosed in initial accounts.

The timing of the leadership meeting underscores ongoing activity within Hamas command structures. The organization did not issue a public statement immediately following the talks, leaving the substantive content of discussions between senior leaders unclear to outside observers.
title: Hamas leaders convene for strategic discussions
